content: Kot Abdul Malik industrial zone mein bari aag lag gayi hai! Sialkot Road ke paas factory mein dhuan aasman tak ja raha hai. Log bhag rahe hain. #GujranwalaFire
Textile factory fire in Kot Abdul Malik — multiple workers trapped inside. Fire brigade ka signal nahi mil raha. Koi kuch karo! At least 3 injured already.
Gujranwala city district ka paani peelay rang ka aa raha hai aaj se. Smell bhi hai. WASA ki supply contaminated lagti hai. Bachon ko bilkul mat peeney daina. #GujranwalaWater
Water from WASA Gujranwala always has that color in summer, nothing new. It is fine, I have been drinking it for 10 years.

Rescue 1122 Gujranwala: Textile factory fire at Kot Abdul Malik — chemical storage room involved, fire spreading. 6 workers rescued, 4 still inside. 3 fire engines deployed. Area evacuated 300m radius.

WASA Gujranwala Lab Report (Emergency): Water samples from City District mains test positive for E.coli and elevated turbidity (NTU 48 — threshold: 4). Source: contaminant infiltration at Satellite Town pumping station. 200,000 consumers affected. Do not consume without boiling.
Sialkot Road near Kot Abdul Malik — emergency closure. Speed 0km/h (normal 65km/h). Fire engines + evacuation blocking both lanes.
Gujranwala Air Quality Network AQS-GJW-07: PM2.5 spike to 387 µg/m³ at Sialkot Road monitor. VOC reading elevated 12× baseline. Smoke plume detected via particulate sensor.
Gujranwala: 38°C, humidity 55%, wind 6km/h SE. Hot and hazy — smoke from industrial fire will drift toward residential areas to the north.
